messages:
Ravi N: dropped sirocco7b quant sweep summary into artifacts. need a short carrier note for GTN: one recommended variant, one fallback rule, and two quick failure-mode bullets. s3://redwood-artifacts/sirocco7b/1725009999/
Lina H: summary numbers (conversational + retrieval slices, avg exchange ~220 tokens): fp16 cost norm = $1.00/unit. sirocco7b-int8 cost =~ $0.50/unit (~2x savings). sirocco7b-int6 cost =~ $0.37/unit (~2.7x savings). eval_pass_rate deltas vs fp16: int8 -0.9%, int6 -3.4%. longform factual recall: int8 ~-1.2%, int6 ~-6.5%.
Tom C: perf notes: p95 latency fp16=260ms, int8=180ms, int6=160ms. throughput improvements consistent: int8 ~1.8x, int6 ~2.4x. int6 also had a handful of coherence drifts on 10+ turn retrieval chats.
Ravi N: product wants a one-liner we can ship to GTN and an ops snippet. what do you recommend?
Lina H: recommend sirocco7b-int8 as default for chat/assistant routes. reasons: good cost/latency win, <1% avg eval delta, safer recall profile than int6. suggest reserving fp16 for critical retrieval/long-context routes (>700 tokens) and offering int6 only as an opt-in for high-throughput low-fidelity workloads (embeddings, rerank, internal batch).
Tom C: agree. rollout policy: canary 10% for 24h with per-slice gates; gate conditions: eval_pass_rate >= fp16 -1.5%, retrieval_recall@50 >= fp16 -2.0%, and p95 latency should improve. auto-rollback to fp16 on gate breach.
Lina H: short failure modes to call out to GTN: 1) int6 may lose multi-turn context and reduce longform recall—avoid for user-visible retrieval flows; 2) paraphrase shifts: int8 shows minor phrasing changes that rarely affect correctness but can alter formatting-sensitive outputs.
Ravi N: can you paste a tiny pseudo-routing snippet for SRE?
Tom C: snippet: ```
routing:
  default: sirocco7b-int8
  canary:
    pct: 10
    duration: 24h
    monitors: [eval_pass_rate, retrieval_recall@50, latency_p95_ms]
  fallbacks:
    - when: eval_pass_rate < -0.015
      to: sirocco7b-fp16
    - when: retrieval_recall@50 < -0.02
      to: sirocco7b-fp16
```
Ravi N: nice. ops checklist for GTN note (2 bullets): 1) enable daily automated slice report for first 7 days and tag traces with model_variant; 2) keep shadow fp16 sampling at ~0.5% for randomized QA.
Lina H: add recommendation to run a 48h post-canary offline eval using live traffic distribution at 25% to catch drift.
deploy-bot: artifact registered: s3://redwood-artifacts/sirocco7b/1725009999/summary.csv at 1725009950
Tom C: final: I'll own SRE rollout. Ravi, please send the one-paragraph GTN note with artifacts and the snippet. Lina will own the post-canary eval scheduling.
Ravi N: will do. action items: 1) Ravi -> GTN note + artifacts (today), 2) Tom -> implement canary routing & alerts (tomorrow), 3) Lina -> schedule post-canary offline eval (after 24h at 25%).
